content_metadata.description: A fan-made trailer for the sequel to 'I Am Legend', depicting a post-apocalyptic world ravaged by a deadly infection, where Will Smith's character is the last immune human.

qAndA.question: What color is the haze covering the destroyed city Will Smith walks through?

qAndA.answer: A sword (although he also uses guns)
qAndA.question: What kind of weapon does Will Smith primarily use against the infected?

qAndA.answer: "We did". It implies that human actions likely led to the outbreak, adding a layer of responsibility and guilt to the narrative.
qAndA.question: What does the voiceover say that caused the situation?

qAndA.answer: The trailer evokes a combination of despair, hope, and action. It begins with a sense of hopelessness and devastation, then gradually transitions towards a hopeful tone with the introduction of Will Smith's immunity and his fight for a cure. The intense action scenes further add to the excitement and anticipation for the potential sequel.
qAndA.question: What is the overall mood of the trailer?

activities.description: Exhaust pipe of a car accelerating
Traffic jam in a city from above

characterInteraction.description: Will Smith appears worried, reflecting the general mood of the scene.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The scene suggests the fragility of human civilization in the face of an unknown threat, and how easily order can descend into chaos.

mood.description: Anxious. The visuals of the crowded city, the jets flying over, and the people wearing masks, combined with the worried voiceover and the fast cuts, all contribute to a feeling of unease and anxiety.

keyMoments.changeDescription: From a neutral mood (jets, cars) to anxiety as the crowds with masks appear and the voiceover describes the situation.

narrativeProgression.description: The scene sets the stage for a post-apocalyptic world where an unknown infection has spread, causing widespread panic and chaos.
The voiceover states that all communications are down and the government is silent, indicating a complete societal collapse.
Will Smith's line 'We don't know who or what is causing this' highlights the mystery surrounding the infection.

scenes.thematicElements: Isolation, societal collapse, fear of the unknown.
scenes.title: Scene 1

activities.description: Aerial view of a deserted city with a river full of boats
CCTV footage of infected running in a hospital hallway

characterInteraction.description: No direct interaction, but Alicia Braga's sadness emphasizes the human cost of the outbreak.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The scene highlights the theme of human vulnerability in the face of a pandemic, and the devastating consequences it can have on society.

mood.description: Sad, hopeless. The visuals of the abandoned city, the chaotic supermarket, and the infected running in the hospital, paired with the somber voiceover and slow-motion shots, create a feeling of sadness and despair.

keyMoments.changeDescription: From sadness to a sense of impending doom with the text 'NO ONE CAN ESCAPE THIS OUTBREAK'.
Back to sadness with Alicia Braga's mournful expression.

narrativeProgression.description: The scene continues to paint a bleak picture of the world after the outbreak, focusing on the widespread devastation and the relentless nature of the infection.
Voiceover mentions 7 billion people on Earth were infected, emphasizing the global scale of the tragedy.
Alicia Braga's line 'There was so much chaos after the outbreak' reinforces the societal breakdown.

scenes.thematicElements: Loss, despair, the struggle for survival.
scenes.title: Scene 2

videoEditingDetails.description: Text 'NO ONE CAN ESCAPE THIS OUTBREAK'

activities.description: People in hazmat suits collecting bodies in a parking garage
Crowd pushing against a police car

characterInteraction.description: Will Smith's statement reveals his role as a survivor, adding depth to his character.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The scene suggests that even in the darkest of times, there is hope for survival and the potential for rebuilding.

mood.description: Tense, uncertain. The visuals of the body collection and the struggling crowd, along with the determined voiceover, create a sense of tension and uncertainty.

narrativeProgression.description: The scene shifts focus to the survivors, highlighting their struggle to cope with the aftermath of the outbreak.
Will Smith's line 'I'm a survivor living in New York City' introduces the main character and his perspective.

scenes.thematicElements: Survival, resilience, the human will to live.
scenes.title: Scene 3

activities.description: Police car driving down a deserted street

characterInteraction.description: Will Smith and his dog are alone, underscoring the feeling of loneliness.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The scene visually depicts the immense scale of loss and emptiness left behind by the outbreak.

mood.description: Lonely, melancholic. The slow-paced visuals of the empty streets and abandoned buildings, combined with the absence of dialogue and music, contribute to a sense of loneliness and desolation.

narrativeProgression.description: The scene emphasizes Will Smith's isolation as a survivor in a post-apocalyptic world.

scenes.thematicElements: Isolation, loneliness, the vastness of the empty world.
scenes.title: Scene 4

activities.description: Will Smith holding a sword, looking upwards

characterInteraction.description: Their determined expressions suggest a shared resolve to fight back.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The scene introduces the idea of immunity as a beacon of hope for cure.

mood.description: Determined, hopeful. The close-up shots of Alicia Braga and Will Smith's determined expressions, along with the text 'I AM IMMUNE,' create a sense of hope and resilience.

narrativeProgression.description: The scene hints at the possibility of immunity to the infection and the potential for finding a cure.

scenes.title: Scene 5

videoEditingDetails.description: Text 'I WAS A SURVIVOR' fades out

activities.description: Dog walking in a deserted area
Will Smith walking through a destroyed city covered in a yellow haze
Will Smith standing by the sea, looking at destroyed ships
Will Smith petting his dog in a forest

characterInteraction.description: Their bond signifies companionship in isolation.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The scene visually represents the burden Will Smith carries as the sole beacon of hope in a devastated world.

mood.description: Determined, lonely. The visuals of the destroyed city and deserted landscapes, coupled with Will Smith's solitary figure and the repeated text 'I AM THE ONLY HOPE', evoke a sense of determination but also profound loneliness.

keyMoments.changeDescription: From a melancholic mood to sudden action and tension as Will Smith yells "I don't wanna shoot you!" and fires his gun.

narrativeProgression.description: The scene further emphasizes Will Smith's isolation as the last immune human and his responsibility to find a cure for humanity.

scenes.thematicElements: Isolation, responsibility, the weight of hope.
scenes.title: Scene 6

videoEditingDetails.description: Slow-paced shots of Will Smith and his dog in different desolate locations

activities.description: Will Smith shooting a gun in the dark
Will Smith driving a car through a destroyed city
Crowd of infected running towards a house

characterInteraction.description: Will Smith's actions against the infected emphasize his struggle for survival.

scenes.contextualRelevance: This scene underscores the relentless threat from the infected and the survivor's fight to stay alive.

mood.description: Intense, action-packed. The fast cuts, gunshots, explosions, and the menacing visuals of the infected create a high-energy and thrilling atmosphere.

narrativeProgression.description: The scene showcases the constant danger Will Smith faces from the infected and his fight for survival.

scenes.thematicElements: Action, danger, survival against the odds.
scenes.title: Scene 7

videoEditingDetails.description: Black screen with Will Smith's voiceover

activities.description: Infected chasing a woman down an alley
Will Smith and Alicia Braga shooting guns
Will Smith face to face with an infected in a fire

characterInteraction.description: Will Smith confronts the infected in a climactic showdown.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The scene implies a potential sacrifice on Will Smith's part, suggesting he may be facing an impossible choice in order to save humanity.

mood.description: Climactic, intense. The fast-paced editing, the action scenes, the dramatic music, and Will Smith's desperate scream all contribute to a sense of climax and heightened tension.

keyMoments.changeDescription: From frantic action to a brief pause with the dramatic reveal of the 'I AM LEGEND 2' title.
Transition to a slow-motion, dramatic face-off between Will Smith and the infected, heightening the tension.

narrativeProgression.description: This scene acts as the climax of the trailer, showcasing Will Smith's ultimate confrontation with the infected.

scenes.thematicElements: Sacrifice, hope, the struggle against overwhelming odds.

13 years have passed since the virus that wiped the world. Robert Neville (Will Smith) and Anna (Alice Braga) becomes a world known heroes that brought the cure. Suddenly a sudden outbreak hits the city of South Korea. Eventually Robert and Anna later learns that this virus was twice deadly than before. 

Hey guys I would like to make it clear that this trailer is fan made. That means it contains clips from other movies, put together with special effects using Wondershare Filmora video editor and Photopea (Photopea.com) photo editor.

►What is a Dream Trailer?

I personally call fan made trailers 'dream trailers' because in a nutshell they are created for extreme movie fans. That's why its not for everybody because just like Pro-Wrestling, some hate it some love it. If you are into dream trailers which means you appreciate bringing new ideas to your favorite movies. But my trailers, are not like any other, one word to describe it, REALISTIC.

Originally Will Smith said 6 Billion people in the world. Since this movie was created in 2007 now 2019 there is 7 billion so I looked for interviews when he said seven and just edited it. I wanted to make this trailer similar to the trailer of the original movie. Which means I used the same style of font for the wordings. I also used some original segment like "God didn't do this, we did"


The process of creating this fan made trailer I had to re search different types of movie that contains these kinds of scenes, apocalyptic, original cast and zombies. Some wordings in the trailer also was similar to the original movie trailer. Instead of using "I Am" all the time, I used "I was" referring to the previews movie. For example "I was a survivor" and "I was the only human being on earth". But then I used "I am" to make it fit with the title and create an impact title sequence.
